fusions.name: Shaken Dry
fusions.desc: Shakes the water off your skin, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave each one [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shooing Jet
fusions.desc: Squirts a jet of water from your siphon at the first enemy it meets, dealing 10 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it [Damped] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip the Blow
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds you take no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Two Hearts to Spare
fusions.desc: Once every 5 minutes, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
